messages:
kevin: Quick summary: recurring Dedicated warmup failures again this month. I grouped recent incidents and sketched short/long-term actions. Need owners and ETA.

irene: paste the grouped signatures and an example log please.

kevin: signatures:
- modprobe/udev timeout during init -> warmup abort
- kernel panic after driver update -> node reboot loop
- autoscaler eviction race during shard download

example:
```
[2026-03-20T05:21:12Z] warmup: fetching shard 2/8
[2026-03-20T05:21:15Z] kernel: NVRM: Xid 79 gfx error
[2026-03-20T05:21:16Z] node-agent: warmup timed out -> evicting pod
```

pat: looks like spikes near vendor rollouts. any recent rollouts?

mike: vendor pushed firmware to eu pools on 2026-03-10 and to us pools on 2026-03-18.

ops-bot: [ALERT] 1957002501 warmup_failure_burst detected for pool:redwood-dedicated-usw-02 (3 spikes in 12h)

kevin: Proposed immediate (48h):
- irene: rollback firmware on affected nodes (owner: irene) - due 2026-03-23 EOD
- pat: add single-retry + extended timeout to modprobe step behind FF (owner: pat) - due 2026-03-23 noon
- mike: routing weight adjust away from pools with >2 failures (owner: mike) - due 2026-03-23 EOD

longer-term (2-6 weeks):
- infra: enforce firmware/AMI pinning + rollout gating (owner: irene + infra) - due 2026-04-15
- runtime: autoscaler lease so warmup pods are protected (owner: pat) - due 2026-04-05
- obs: "warmup-recurrence" dashboard and weekly recurrence alert (owner: mike) - due 2026-03-30
- pm/ops: add recurrence fields to postmortem template (recurrence_count, hypothesis_tag) and require for infra PMs (owner: kevin) - due 2026-04-01

irene: starting rollback ticket TKT-6801 now and will include smoke tests.

pat: PR for retry landed in staging behind FF; metrics show fewer transient failures on canary.

mike: router change staged in staging; will monitor. dashboard draft at https://go/internal/dashboards/warmup-recurrence (will post when ready).

kevin: owners, please update TKT-6801 with runbooks, verification, and expected close dates. We'll reconvene in 2 weeks to assess recurrence and decide closure vs escalation.

ops-bot: [INFO] TKT-6801 created and assigned to irene; priority: high

kevin: scheduling a 25m sync on #incidents for 2026-03-29 to review metrics and close items. Thread paused until owners post updates.
